SAMSAM THUBANE - SPINNING RIGHT ROUND

By: Nicky Troll | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Sam Sam Thubane is taking South Africa’s rawest street culture global - but before the world knew his name… it started in Mbombela.

Unique Selling Point:
- South African Guy that's now an international stunt super star.
- GREAT footage
- fascinating SA street culture experienced globally
- a story of growth, camaraderie and success

Summary:
From Mbombela Streets to Global Stages. Sam Sam Thubane’s journey represents the modern face of spinning in 2025. From the streets of Mbombela to performing at the Red Bull Hangar-7 reopening in Salzburg, Austria in June, his rise exemplifies how spinning has transcended its local origins to become a globally recognized spectacle. His story perfectly captures what Vic describes as spinning's unique accessibility - it remains the only motorsport that welcomes participants from all backgrounds and communities, making it truly democratic in a way no other motorsport can claim
Samkeliso “Sam Sam” Thubane is a spinner from Nelspruit, in Mpumalanga.

Further information:
We meet SamSam in Mbombela – do a day in the life of the global super star changing perceptions about a risky sport and taking SA street culture to global stages

This is a feature about Samkeliso Thubane – not spinning. Understanding his journey from Mbombela to international fame. Leaning into the theme that SamSam isn’t just spinning cars. He’s spinning culture, identity, and possibility.

ELEMENTS WE’D LIKE TO COVER

1. SAMKELISO – we’d like to interview him on the go in visually interesting settings – possibly at the spin pit? Starting at home maybe? We don’t want it to be boring formal sit down interview – imagine a day in the life of Sam, seeing where he started and exploring the huge success his achieved by understanding his roots.
2. SAMKELISO’S CREW – we’d like to meet the guys with Sam ideally, at a mechanic type place that will be visually interesting. We want to build into the story that while Sam is in the spotlight, it’s a team sport with lots of people working with him behind the scenes.
3. SAMKELISO’s FAMILY – we’d like to interview one of his parent – about how proud they are his accomplishments and how they’ve seen him grow as a young kid into a global phenomenon.
4. EARLY DAY – MR. Elvis? – we’d like to feature someone that knew Sam as young kid starting out to speak about seeing potential and how Sam was a youngster.
5. SPIN SCENE – we want to do a bit of show off demo incorporating our presenter.

FINAL SCRIPT | SAM SAM THUBANE SPINNING


[GOVAN]: From humble beginnings to the global stage….

A thrill-seeke-r turned trailblazer.

This is the story of Sam Sam Thubane.

[GOVAN]: Red Bull’s Hangar-7 at Salzburg Airport, in Austria, is home to legendary aircraft and Formula One machines. Earlier this year, it staged an electrifying display of daredevils and stuntmen.

And amid the spectacle, our very own Sam Sam.

[SAM SAM]: Before I went into the pit, I was so nervous I’m like joh, I’m all the way up in Austria, very far from home. [laughs] So everyone's waiting to see, I mean, what's this boy going to do?

[GOVAN]: What he did blew the crowd away; a performance that floored even some Formula One drivers.

[LIAM LAWSON]: How is he? What? This guy is seriously brave. Yeah, it’s, it’s pretty sick.
[ISACK HADJAR]: How is…how is the…how is the car even driving itself? This guy’s crazy – what’s his name? Samkeliso Sam Sam – you are crazy!

[GOVAN]: He’s taking South Africa’s rawest street culture global - but before the world knew his name… it started right here – in Numbi, just outside of Mbombela.

[GOVAN]: It’s a motorsport born on South African streets in the 1980s. It’s all about smoke, stunts, and speed - a mix of control and chaos.

[GOVAN]: Yoh, Sam Sam.
[SAM SAM]: How you man?
[GOVAN]: Howzit! Govan. Nice to meet you man.
[SAM SAM]: Nice to meet you, buddy.
[GOVAN]: What does it feel like a relief to be like, “yeah, I’m back under the African sun”?
[SAM SAM]: Well, it really does, hey. Just besides that, I'm preparing for another show, it never stops.

[GOVAN]: While still illegal on the streets, it’s now hitting the mainstream as spinning roars in arenas across South Africa.

Sam Sam’s had crowds on their feet from the age of just 12.

[SAM SAM]: I used to like do those quad bikes.
[GOVAN]: Around here?
[SAM SAM]: Yeah! You know when you’re in the streets and then there's these guys spinning the E30s and all that.
[GOVAN]: Yeah.
[SAM SAM]: I fell in love with the spinning sport. And then, lucky enough, my father was also like, like in love with the same thing. So, got me a E30 and then the rest is history.

[GOVAN]: 15 years later…

And Sam Sam is now, Red Bull's first professional spinning athlete. But he’s not just a spinner…. he’s a precision driver.

Before reaching the global stage, he was shown the ropes by Nicolas Moosa, a local spinning legend who took him under his wing.

Nicholas recalls meeting Sam Sam as a kid - wide-eyed and hungry to spin.

[NICHOLAS]: Then I asked Sam Sam can you drive? He said, yes. I said, can you spin? He said yes. I said, okay, come show me. He jumped into the car and I was like, you're not going to make it to the pedals. We moved the seat all the way to the front. We forced the seat almost onto the steering and the dash. And, it wasn't, within two three hours he was already catching the stick.
[GOVAN]: Catching the stick?
[NICHOLAS]: No, yeah, he was a very fast learner. When he first did his first donut, I was like
[NICHOLAS SUB TITLE] “Waar toe gaan ons nou?”
[NICHOLAS]: And then, I stopped him and I said to him, try this, do this. And he did it.
[GOVAN]: And then how did you react?
[NICHOLAS]: I was shocked, I was shocked.

[GOVAN]: While Nicolas and other mentors taught Sam Sam the basics, he’s developed his own identity - turning chaos into art.

This 2015 clip shows him doing tricks in a Toyota bakkie, fitted with a BMW engine.

[NICHOLAS]: The guys who do stunts, they’ve perfected it. It comes with a lot of, lot of, lot of brains. Look, spinning you’re in the car. You're in control of the car. Stunts you out of the car, on top of the car, in the boot. The guys come from all angles, in there the car and outside the car.

[GOVAN]: All Sam Sam’s cars are built in South Africa and shipped overseas for his global performances from South America to Europe.

The car is a Gusheshe - township slang for the BMW 325is - a nod to its speed and power of box-shaped, brutal… basically born to spin.

[SAM SAM]: So, this is our recent build. We call it the, the ultimate Gusheshe.
[GOVAN]: [LAUGHS]
[SAM SAM]: It's the ultimate Gusheshe, as you can see.
[GOVAN]: Yeah ride around in the Gusheshe…but you got the same branding on it. How long have you guys taken to build this?
[SAM SAM]: 29 days to build this car.
[GOVAN]: 29 days!
[SAM SAM]: 29 days!
[GOVAN]: Usually the cars that are used for spinning when I see them, they have smooth tires. These look like new tyres, Chief?
[SAM SAM]: These are brand new tyres – front and back.
[GOVAN]: How long do you take with these tyres?
[SAM SAM]: This can give you about three minutes.
[GOVAN]: Three minutes dude!
[SAM SAM]: Three minutes yeah! Three minutes at least.
[GOVAN]: Bro!

[GOVAN]: More than guts are needed to survive in the spin pit. It takes a behind-the-scenes crew drivers can trust with their lives. And for Sam Sam, that’s Team Numbi – the mechanics that keeps his wheels turning.

Colani Thela is one of the original guys who started out with Sam Sam.

[GOVAN]: Do you also spin cars?
[COLANI]: Hmm-hmm. I am afraid of these things. I don't spin.
[GOVAN]: Ah! Colani, but you’re the one building it.
[COLANI]: I don't spin because hey, you see, me I'm fat. He's not fat. Those things of moving, moving around. Jumping out and in. Can I fit here? While it’s spinning? I can’t – I’ll be injured.
[GOVAN]: What is the most important part of the car, for spinning?
[COLANI]: I think it's the engine.
[GOVAN]: Not the tyres, hey?
[COLANI]: Not the tyres. Tyres, we can take tyres from somewhere and put. But the engine, you can't just take the engine from another car and put here.
[GOVAN]: How proud of you are you of this work?
[COLANI]: I also still can't believe that we pulled this kind of stunt, you know, building a car like this, it's like an achievement.

UPSOUND SPINNING

[GOVAN]: How does it look when it comes back.
[COLANI]: When it comes back, ah! it's roughed up.

[GOVAN]: Sam works for the family business when not preforming.

[GOVAN]: So this is your day to day ride, yeah?
[SAM SAM]: Yeah man, this is the workhorse.
[GOVAN]: It’s different from a Gusheshe.

[GOVAN]: But, any chance he gets, he races to his own private spin pit to refine his craft

[SAM SAM]: You just forget everything…

UPSOUND SPINNING

[SAM SAM]: Once you start inhaling the smoke from the tyres, sjoh, it’s happiness one way.

UPSOUND SPINNING – Show them how it’s done.

[GOVAN]: But the pressure is also on, it’s a risky hobby - one mistake can end in disaster.

While Sam Sam’s perfected his signature stunts - the actual manoeuvres stay secret. What he does reveal is an upgraded engine - but with no tweaks to the controls.

[SAM SAM]: Let's go in man, let me take it for a ride.
[GOVAN]: Hey! I'm not scared.
[SAM SAM]: You sure?
[GOVAN]: I'm not, I'm not scared, bro.
[SAM SAM]: We'll see.
[GOVAN]: Let’s go do it. Yeah, well. Whoohooo! Hey, chief. Where do I hold? There's no safety belt nê?.
[SAM SAM]: Just relax.
[GOVAN]: I'm relaxing, I’m relaxing. It's going to be cool. It's going to be cool, right.
[SAM SAM]: WHOOOOO!
[GOVAN]: Hey, I’ve never done this before.
[SAM SAM]: Aah! We’re in it.
[GOVAN]: It’s too late now.

SPIN VISUALS

[GOVAN]: After a day with Sam Sam, I see it - humble and reserved in person, ferocious behind the wheel…

SPIN VISUALS – JUMPING OUT

[GOVAN]: … and fearless when he’s not.

[GOVAN]: Oh man! You’re a magician, bro, you’re magician! You’re a genius! That's incredible, bro! Whoa, whoa! Yeah! My guy!

[GOVAN]: This is not for amateurs, man. What Sam Sam does requires skill. Like, he's seriously talented, when he jumped through the roof, I realized here what we're dealing with not only the best in South Africa, the best in the world. And this undoubtedly has the potential to go global.

[GOVAN]: And from what I’ve seen, Sam Sam isn’t just spinning cars, he’s spinning culture, identity, and possibility.

metadata.Summary: From Mbombela Streets to Global Stages. Sam Sam Thubane’s journey represents the modern face of spinning in 2025. From the streets of Mbombela to performing at the Red Bull Hangar-7 reopening in Salzburg, Austria in June, his rise exemplifies how spinning has transcended its local origins to become a globally recognized spectacle. His story perfectly captures what Vic describes as spinning's unique accessibility - it remains the only motorsport that welcomes participants from all backgrounds and communities, making it truly democratic in a way no other motorsport can claim Samkeliso “Sam Sam” Thubane is a spinner from Nelspruit, in Mpumalanga.
